quotes.text: trust should begin bravely, grow reciprocally, and retreat calmly when repeatedly betrayed, without vengeance.
narrowed bridges only after repeated greed
Keep your hand open to future repair, but do not reward a pattern of withholding with reckless trust.
The Fox of Hunger whispered, “Keep every flame. The masks will change, and memory will fade.”
Fox cried, “Fortune favors the closed fist!” Crane answered, “No harvest survives if courage is punished.”
yet evidence can arise only when someone risks a beginning.
exact pennies mattered less than intent.
Mist blurred several sparks, so the pilgrims judged patterns rather than stray numbers.

note: Mira's measured trust: small tests, reward patterns, calm retreat after repeated greed; Fox voices hoarding, Crane/Owl rebut.

quotes.text: When it narrowed, it narrowed by halves, never slamming; and at the first honest pouring it swung wide again as if nothing had passed.
**a narrowed gate, never a sealed one.**
Those who hoarded found the gate closed gently, and opened again the moment they poured.
One dry crossing it called fog. Three it called a choice.
Only then did he close his channel — not in rage, but as a farmer closes a gate on a field that will not grow.
**Never punish emptiness with emptiness; that is how valleys die agreeing.**
And I am living the proof of my own warning. See how my basin stands full and my orchard dies.
I made mercy into a word and kept it off the water.
*Season seven, sent nothing. Season eight, returned nothing. Season nine, received a trickle and returned nothing still.*
She had reopened the gate in speech and kept it shut in fact — pouring eloquence, withholding water.
because somebody must go first or no one ever does.
A merchant asked why the valley did not simply build a wall against cheats. Ssal answered:
The first gate was **Opening**.
judge intention rather than arithmetic

note: Narrowed-never-sealed gate law; later Vaun and his daughter confess sealing the gate while carving generous laws.

quotes.text: Nothing for unmistakable Serpents.
The Serpent receives nothing from us.
Those who hoard everything deserve only minimal stones.
Even the Serpent may change streams. Throw one or two stones—a measured test.
"This is the Serpent's pattern," Lua said, "unchanged across seasons with every partner." She kept her stones.
generous sending ($4-$5), fair returns (50-60%), season after season.
"Watch the pattern, not just one moment."
"Do I test them anyway?" she asked.
Judge the pattern, not the fog-shrouded moment.
They write myths about caution while their rivers run dry.
those who hoard deserve only caution.

note: Twins' tiered policy: test strangers with two, build with proven, nothing for consistent Serpents; R8 allows re-testing, so withdraw with way back.
